timeline.text: Say 'Hoffsvangen skole' to the bot, and it heard noise — spelling it out phonetically, wrong every time.
It never knew the real name, just sounded it out and guessed.
Now a SQLite table holds the real names and every wrong guess the bot has ever made.
It checks that table first — like a notepad of corrections, not a fresh guess every time.
Hear a name once, and it's matched correctly every time after.
